examples.arabic: احنا ضحكنا كتير كان يوم مضحك
examples.english: We laughed a lot, it was a funny day.
examples.transliteration: ehna dehekna keteer kaan yom modhek

examples.arabic: كل الجمهور ضحك عشان الموقف كان مضحك
examples.english: All the fans laughed because the situation was funny.
examples.transliteration: Koll el-gomhoor dahak 'ashan el-maw'ef kan modhek.
